newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa sells some U.S./Canada ops.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa sells some U.S./Canada ops.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa AB said on Wednesday it had signed a preliminary agreement to sell its received reinsurance operations in the U.S. and Canada.

Trygg-Hansa said in a statement it had been in talks for some time with an international group of investors to sell Trygg-Hansa Forsakrings AB's U.S. and Canadian operations for receiving reinsurance (Hansa Re).
The deal is conditioned on a private placement (AIM) on the London market amoounting to 70 million pounds sterling as well as approval by U.S. and Canadian authorities, the company said.
"The deal is a natural step in the phasing out of received reinsurance and means, if it is finalised, that insurance technical debt is reduced by about 350 million crowns," the company said.
Trygg-Hansa has issued limited guarantees during a period of five years for its previous insurance responsibility.
The deal will free-up $60 million in cash and will generate a small capital gain, the company said.
